week_13: Optional contingency only; official dates/deadlines not confirmed

weekly_work_packages.work: Receive stable chunks and implement E5/pgvector/R0, actual-context evidence and budget interfaces.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Numeric fixtures rank correctly; normal/empty retrieval is callable; citation IDs match text hashes.

weekly_work_packages.work: Reproduce in a copy, port complete assets, and fix bias/oracle/strict parsing/truncation/empty output while establishing shared chat types.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Relevant HC-01–07 checks run; chat input needs no options; historical failure records remain.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Repeated compilation is hash-stable; invalid explicit values fail; defaults and temporary presentation requests are defined.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Fresh and legacy-fixture upgrades pass; one request persists messages and citations with an explicitly mock model if needed.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: No mandatory A–D fields; send has a real database effect; unfinished features cannot claim success.

weekly_work_packages.work: Create 12 conversation families and register 60 scenarios; prioritise generation-migration negatives and thin-slice checks independent of SciQ files.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Expected versus executed checks are separate; the legacy 39-test scope is explicit, not full-project acceptance.

weekly_work_packages.work: Coordinate consumer-side seam tests and accept the chat product, not isolated modules; maintain the end-of-week defect list.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: J1/J2/J3/J4/J6 and no-SciQ chat pass; blockers have explicit owners.

weekly_work_packages.work: Connect deactivation/restoration/reprocessing; separately prepare SciQ evaluation files without indexing support as textbook evidence.
weekly_work_packages.downstream_consumers: Chengzhou Liu; Zeping Liao; Chong Zhang
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: New queries exclude deactivated sources; history is unchanged or explicitly unavailable; chat has no gold mounts.

weekly_work_packages.work: Implement standalone follow-up queries, topic changes, clarification and underlying evidence reuse; record raw and prepared queries.
weekly_work_packages.downstream_consumers: Sijin Lu; Zeping Liao; Chong Zhang
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: The light follow-up uses its real referent; topic changes drop irrelevant evidence; empty retrieval differs from an outage.

weekly_work_packages.work: Extract runtime generation service; connect messages/history/profile/evidence and one bounded retry policy; inspect actual model payloads.
weekly_work_packages.downstream_consumers: Zeping Liao; Pengyuan Xia; Baiqing Huang
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Executable HC-08–11 checks pass; profiles enter one main call, with no silent fallback or lost history.

weekly_work_packages.work: Connect save/reset/snapshot/temporary simplification and verify that disabling profiles retains conversational context.
weekly_work_packages.downstream_consumers: Sijin Lu; Baiqing Huang; Zeping Liao
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: All three policies enter actual requests; historical profile snapshots remain; temporary requests do not rewrite saved level.

weekly_work_packages.work: Complete shared orchestration, recent context/extractive summaries, transactional publication, retry and latest-answer revisions; sync client contracts.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Duplicate send deduplicates; refresh restores; failed regeneration preserves old answer; summaries exclude future/other-session text.

weekly_work_packages.work: Connect the chat workspace, evidence drawer, profiles, feedback, stop/retry/regenerate, history and corpus status.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Natural multi-turn flow works; Enter/Shift+Enter, failed drafts and re-login behave correctly; controls have real effects.

weekly_work_packages.work: Run 12 conversation families and recovery negatives; finish independent evaluation adapters and metric math tests; label live semantic checks separately.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: No-SciQ operation, reference/clarification/topic/summary/profile/revision checks inspect actual records.

weekly_work_packages.work: Freeze protocols, manifests, configurations and reporting; continue fixing chat defects without replacing product acceptance with scores.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: OpenQA/MCQ directories and denominators are separate; unrun studies remain blocked, not passed.

weekly_work_packages.work: Verify available SciQ revision/splits/hashes and corpus manifests; provide source locators for annotation.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: System-visible exports contain only protocol fields; support is absent from the textbook index.

weekly_work_packages.work: Stabilise R0 traces and review source coverage; implement R1 in parallel without changing frozen E1.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: The same release reproduces candidate order; a retrieval miss alone does not prove absent source coverage.

weekly_work_packages.work: Connect OpenQA/MCQ contracts and actual provider metadata to the formal runner; run a separate live smoke when configured and authorised.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Inputs/settings are comparable; examples do not select a verified model; preserve the historical probe.

weekly_work_packages.work: Recheck product profiles; prepare rating templates and fixed-level cases without delaying already-required chat features.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Baseline inputs exclude profiles while normal chat retains them; rating templates contain no fabricated scores.

weekly_work_packages.work: Implement experiment runs/items, freeze/cancel/resume/export through shared AnswerExecutionService without fake learner sessions.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: All scheduled items retain outcomes; stopping the evaluator does not affect chat_ready.

weekly_work_packages.work: Build secondary admin evaluation/results views showing protocol, mock/live and failure counts; continue chat UX fixes.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Learner landing remains /chat; exports use actual server records, not invented frontend metrics.

weekly_work_packages.work: Freeze coverage review and run manifests; execute E0/E1 or record blockers, separately calculating EM/F1, MCQ and semantic review.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Failures/refusals remain in N; aliases/references never enter generation; HC-12 and denominator fixtures pass.

weekly_work_packages.work: Review variant controls and code diffs; integrate improvements without requiring unsupported positive gains.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Every comparison identifies changed/fixed factors; the prior baseline is not overwritten.

weekly_work_packages.work: Build fixed-window/structure-aware releases with span mappings and re-annotate qrels where necessary.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Incompatible chunk IDs are not reused; old answer text/hashes remain unchanged.

weekly_work_packages.work: Deliver BM25, RRF, re-ranking and chunk/embedding/k ablations; distinguish executable code from blocked measurements when models are unavailable.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: RRF matches hand calculations; changed embedding dimensions get compatible indexes; no hidden R3 fallback.

weekly_work_packages.work: Implement matched-policy controls and versioned prompts, recording timing/usage/errors without attributing multi-factor changes solely to retrieval.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Protocols remain distinct, reuse the shared engine and do not alter chat entry; a second live model remains optional.

weekly_work_packages.work: Prepare C0/C1/C2 inputs, frozen base responses/evidence and blinded rubrics for the next week.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Study and product configurations are separate; gold never replaces the base response.

weekly_work_packages.work: Connect variant versions/run traces and embedding storage boundaries; verify backend/client schema synchronisation.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Switching retrievers does not rewrite login/history/evidence; legacy migration fixtures pass.

weekly_work_packages.work: Complete comparison/configuration/failure-trace views and historical citation rendering after corpus changes.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Display actual denominators and missing metrics; old citations never silently target new content.

weekly_work_packages.work: Check single-factor comparisons, compatible qrels and paired samples; produce at least one real controlled finding when inputs permit.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Retain negative findings, keep missing labels null and identify exactly which comparisons were not executed.

weekly_work_packages.work: Confirm study samples and real review arrangements; control remaining scope without adding large features.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Research and engineering gaps are separate; naming reviewers is not evidence of performed ratings.

weekly_work_packages.work: Freeze study source spans/releases, complete data dictionary/rebuild notes and address remaining source anomalies.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Study evidence is locatable; missing originals/use constraints are explicit, without expanding knowledge-source scope.

weekly_work_packages.work: Finish retrieval ablations, analyse misses/context exclusions and freeze evidence for profile studies.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Matched profile items hold question/evidence fixed; comparison data remains traceable.

weekly_work_packages.work: Implement separate TeachingStudyService/schema and generate C0/C1/C2 explanations; product chat still uses one main generation.

weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Study outputs do not append learner messages or mutate the base response; usage is per study item.

weekly_work_packages.work: Run the frozen level/condition matrix, check supported-meaning preservation and prepare randomised blinded review with anchored criteria.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Report actual output count rather than assuming 270; missing ratings are null; structural checks are not semantic proof.

weekly_work_packages.work: Persist separate study items/outputs/rating references; complete result reads and feedback review, checking transactions.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: User chat and study identities are separate; feedback has an operator handling path.

weekly_work_packages.work: Polish applied-profile visibility, feedback review and result exports; test keyboard and narrow-screen behaviour.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Current profiles differ clearly from historical snapshots; status does not depend on colour alone.

weekly_work_packages.work: Collect actual independent ratings/disagreements, reconcile samples/pairs/missingness and start full negative/fault regression.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Without actual ratings, claim no learning effect; cluster repeated outputs by question and retain failures.

weekly_work_packages.work: Audit requirement-to-code mapping, obsolete MCQ-mainline assumptions and blockers; prepare a release candidate.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: No missing IDs, cycles or mandatory-choice remnants; critical defects are fixed or explicitly blocking.

weekly_work_packages.work: Check asset/chunk/vector counts and historical hashes in a separate restore environment; complete quality limitations.

weekly_work_packages.work: Execute R0/R1 and embedding replacement drills and diagnose measured bottlenecks; avoid speculative optimisation.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Shared consumers remain unchanged; dimension changes use explicit migrations/new indexes, never mixed writes.

weekly_work_packages.work: Regress empty/truncated responses, HTTP errors, duplicate JSON keys, budgets and live configuration; reconcile actual generation evidence.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Legacy 39 tests and new HC results remain separate; aggregate retry counts agree and mocks cannot masquerade as live.

weekly_work_packages.work: Complete available ratings and review misleading analogies, negation and formulas; write findings and limitations.
weekly_work_packages.acceptance: Examples trace to run/profile/rater; unrated items do not receive default high scores.

weekly_work_packages.work: Run full browser regression for stop/retry/latest-answer revision/account switch/re-login/history evidence.
